services.label: GitHub · islas-voladoras
services.usage_ratio_note: Repo API size is ~0.9% of GitHub's 10 GB recommended repository-size ceiling; API size is not identical to local .git on-disk size.
risks: Repository is PUBLIC: never store secrets, private contracts, personal data or unreleased sensitive masters here.
Large binaries should not accumulate in ordinary Git history.
next: Use LFS or external persistent storage for large binaries when needed.
Track Actions artifact/caches separately if they become material.

services.label: Google Drive · ISL workspace

reference_limits.note: Actual user quota may be larger via Google One/Workspace; do not infer account plan.

risks: Visible project footprint is already multi-GB.
Account-wide remaining quota cannot be read from the current connector.
Drive is archive/master storage, not a low-latency game CDN.
next: Keep masters, briefs, provenance and backups in Drive.
Add CDN/object storage only when verified runtime binary/volume/performance need exists.
Periodically deduplicate masters/exports without deleting source-of-truth.

services.label: Unreal Engine · production storage
guidance: Derived Data Cache is disposable/regenerable and should not be committed to source control.
Epic recommends shared DDC/Zen Storage as teams and project size grow.
Virtual Assets can reduce local sync/disk pressure for large projects.
next: Instrument project Content size, Saved/Intermediate size and DDC separately when Unreal production lane activates.
Choose persistent binary source strategy before multi-person Unreal production.
Do not migrate infrastructure before real size/team pain exists.
